entries.title: Thai font defaults and editable OMML routing
entries.summary: Use shared document defaults, Thai/Latin run routing and editable math insertion instead of generator-local OOXML copies.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Current shared font/OMML functions exist and every promoted entry has resolvable implementation and test ownership.

entries.title: Fixed table grid and width emission
entries.summary: Emit deterministic fixed table grids and explicit cell widths through the shared builder.

acceptance_tests.assertion: The shared fixed-width implementation reference resolves and historical recurrence remains represented.

entries.title: Cell margin primitive
entries.summary: Provide semantic cell-margin control instead of repeated direct tcMar construction.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Cell margins emit deterministic logical-side OOXML and remain idempotent.

entries.title: Border and clear-border primitive
entries.summary: Provide one shared API for cell/table borders and explicit border clearing.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Border controls retain explicit nil and single distinctions without duplicate nodes.

entries.title: Cell and heading shading primitive
entries.summary: Centralize repeated OOXML shading while keeping color/profile selection outside the primitive.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Shading emits one deterministic node while project colors remain caller-owned.

entries.title: Thai-styled dotted response line
entries.summary: Render literal dots with TH Sarabun New 16 pt for approved student response lines.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Dotted response lines use literal periods and TH Sarabun New 16 pt in all font slots.

entries.title: Current student-facing table width profile
entries.summary: Use 16 cm for one column and 8.5 cm per column only for an explicit equal two-column request.

acceptance_tests.assertion: One current profile emits 16 cm for one column and an unshrunk 8.5 cm by 2 explicit layout.

entries.title: Native-column practice exam profile
entries.summary: Use native Word columns for the approved objective-exam flow and return to one column for written work.

acceptance_tests.assertion: The approved opening, two-native-column objective and written-section sequence emits exact column facts.

entries.title: Editable SVG diagram policy
entries.summary: Keep SVG as the editable source and apply approved physical-size/layering rules for Word workflows.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Editable SVG policy never rasterizes silently and requires a visibly reviewed extension until native insertion is shared.

entries.title: High-resolution PNG answer-visual policy
entries.summary: Use PNG only for approved position-stable answer visuals while retaining editable source and keeping equations out of images.

acceptance_tests.assertion: PNG answer visuals require an editable source, reject equations inside images and remain QA-marked.

entries.title: Repeat table header control
entries.summary: Provide deterministic table-header repetition as a shared layout primitive.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Repeat-header control updates one deterministic Word header node.

entries.title: Fixed question-grid material pattern
entries.summary: Promote a semantic question-grid pattern above the fixed-width table primitive.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Question grids preserve row-major order and use only current explicit width profiles.

entries.title: Worked-example material pattern
entries.summary: Provide a semantic worked-example pattern backed by recurrence and an approved teaching progression.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Worked examples assemble semantic prompt and steps while math remains editable OMML.

entries.title: Thai mathematics handout recipe
entries.summary: Assemble explanations, worked examples, practice and response areas through thin family recipes.

acceptance_tests.assertion: The thin handout recipe assembles shared introduction, worked-example and practice patterns.

entries.title: Exam-paper family recipe
entries.summary: Assemble objective/written sections, question blocks and media through a thin exam recipe owned by the future exam skill.

acceptance_tests.assertion: The thin exam recipe keeps objective question-grid and written response-area patterns separate.

entries.title: Detailed answer-key recipe
entries.summary: Provide a thin answer-key assembly recipe while the exam skill owns family variants.

acceptance_tests.assertion: The thin answer-key recipe preserves editable answer math and semantic explanation steps.

entries.title: DOCX structural self-audit rule
entries.summary: Move generator-local package assertions into the central QA runner while preserving deterministic safety checks.

acceptance_tests.assertion: The unified runner combines mandatory package/font/OMML/media/layout/mutation checks with exact verdicts and exit codes.

entries.title: Per-item right-extension override
entries.summary: Keep the approved logic-exam right-extension as a candidate profile override until forward tests show broader need.

entries.title: Section transition primitive
entries.summary: Provide explicit section creation and transition control as a shared layout primitive before native-column profiles assemble it.

acceptance_tests.assertion: Section transitions apply explicit profile geometry and continuous native-column OOXML.

entries.title: Exact historical diagram geometry
entries.summary: Retain item-specific coordinates and label placement as one-off evidence, not a universal layout API.

entries.title: Session-specific handoff state
entries.summary: Preserve accepted/rejected/pending batch state as one-off continuity evidence rather than shared generator behavior.

entries.title: Expression shorthand for math part-dicts
entries.summary: Use the shared expr/paren/frac/sup helpers from thai_math_expr instead of re-defining them per generator; input normalization is centralized and OMML output is unchanged.

acceptance_tests.assertion: expr/paren/frac/sup normalize scalar/dict/list inputs and render OMML identical to the historical generator-local variants.

entries.title: Unmatched generator-specific behavior
entries.summary: Keep factual generator evidence that matches no promoted/candidate pattern as one-off history for later review.

regression_tests.assertion: Exactly one current student-question-layout profile carries the approved response-line and width preferences.
The current logic exam profile remains linked to native-column approval evidence.
The current media policy keeps SVG editability and PNG answer-visual exceptions distinct.
